children: Binance Wallet announced on X that users can access Sports Prediction Markets through the Binance App and Binance Wallet Web. In the Binance App, the path is Exchange, then Markets, then Prediction, then Sports, or Wallet, then Home, then Prediction, then View more, then Sports. On the web, users can navigate through Binance Web, then Trade, then Prediction, then Sports, or Binance Wallet Web, then Prediction, then Sports. The announcement did not provide additional details beyond the access paths.

Prediction Markets are available only to users in eligible regions and may not be available to all users. Binance Wallet did not specify any further rollout details, supported jurisdictions, or timing changes in the announcement. The notice focused on where the Sports section can be found across app and web interfaces and repeated that availability depends on regional eligibility.

title: Binance Wallet Adds Access to Sports Prediction Markets
